definition: Veo, or Google Veo, is a text-to-video model developed by Google DeepMind and announced in May 2024.
details: As a generative AI model, it creates videos based on user prompts. Veo 3, released in May 2025, can also generate accompanying audio.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. It is the exam that separates “it sounds good” from “it actually is good”. What gets measured is what actually gets better. And that, done honestly, is Veo (text-to-video model).
